effects.description: (4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) While you are in Imperial City, you tap into the power of the Tel Var Stones you are carrying, increasing your Health, Magicka, and Stamina by |cffffff24-1032|r. While you have a 4x Tel Var Stone multiplier this effect is increased by |cffffff600|r%.
